newsitem.title: UK: Pricked finger makes man unbearable, doctor says.
newsitem.headline: Pricked finger makes man unbearable, doctor says.

text.p: British doctors pleaded for help on Friday in solving the case of a man whose infected hand makes him too smelly to be around.
The 29-year-old man has suffered from the putrid hand for five years and nothing seems to clear up the infection, Caroline Mills and colleagues at the University of Wales said.
He developed the infection in 1991 when he pricked his finger with a bone while at work dressing chicken carcasses, they wrote in a letter to the Lancet medical journal.
Mills said she could not identify the bacteria that was infecting the victim's hand and various antibiotics failed to clear it up.

"Although the clinical appearance improved, the most disabling consequence of the infection was a putrid smell emanating from the affected arm, which could be detected across a large room and, when confined to a smaller examination room, became almost intolerable," they wrote.

"This illness is unique and has caused chronic disability and social isolation because of his overpowering odour," they added. "We ask assistance from colleagues who may have encountered a similar case or for suggestions to relieve this patient's odour even if the organism cannot be eradicated."
